views.actor_descendants:
SELECT root_actor_id,
    descendant_actor_id,
    depth,
    path
   FROM actor_descendant_edge;
views.actor_fact_current_v2:
SELECT f.actor_fact_id,
    f.actor_id,
    f.topic_id,
    f.fact_type,
    f.fact_key,
    f.fact_value,
    f.collection_state,
    f.layer,
    f.source_id,
    f.source_origin,
    f.confidence,
    f.observed_at,
    f.retrieved_at,
    f.generated_by,
    f.request_id,
    f.created_at,
    f.semantic_hash,
    f.creator_class,
    f.lifecycle_state,
    f.supersedes_fact_id,
    true AS is_current
   FROM (actor_fact_current_pointer p
     JOIN actor_fact f ON ((f.actor_fact_id = p.actor_fact_id)));
views.actor_fact_history:
SELECT f.actor_fact_id,
    f.actor_id,
    f.topic_id,
    f.fact_type,
    f.fact_key,
    f.fact_value,
    f.collection_state,
    f.layer,
    f.source_id,
    f.source_origin,

    f.observed_at,
